heldout_term: 0.85*tanh(1.7*x1 + 0.8*x2) added at the single changed node
assay: four responses per node (120 total), rank by scratch-minus-source Gaussian log evidence
adaptive_allocation: ten additional responses on each top-eight ranked node (80 total)
uniform_allocation: 80 additional responses in quotient/remainder node-index order
soft_mixture: full-acquired-data Gaussian source-warm/scratch mean mixture with fixed scratch prior mass 0.1
primary_score: independent 1024-context noise-free conditional-mean MSE, including the held-out term
gate: For each source size on heldout_tanh: adaptive soft_mixture changed-node mean MSE <=0.8x uniform soft_mixture and <=1.05x adaptive scratch; adaptive soft_mixture unchanged-node mean MSE <=1.05x uniform soft_mixture and <=1.05x adaptive source_warm. Both source-size strata must pass. Matched-family is descriptive positive control.
custody: 40 source cells, 80 target setting cells, 48000 counted source responses, 32000 target arm-response counts. Hash source data/posteriors, acquired target rows, system/evaluation specification and metrics. Report unique union prefixes and deterministic replay.
forbidden: No changed label, latent coefficient, test design or private outcome enters allocation or fitting. No Azure or other closed-source model calls. Do not retune function, top-eight size, source prior, seed set or gate after outcomes.
